_about: Hand-labelled ground truth for PyJWT 2.8.0 shipped code (jwt/).
Produced by inspecting the source line by line, NOT by reading ECDAT output.
Each entry records what a cryptographic auditor would independently say is
present at that location. This is the corpus the real accuracy number is
computed from; the self-authored fixture benchmark is only a regression test.
method: manual line-by-line source review of fixtures/pyjwt_repo/jwt/*.py

labelled_files.negative_reason: api_jws.py is encoding/serialisation logic. It calls str.encode() and str.decode() for UTF-8 handling and performs no cryptography itself. Its one 'cryptographic-looking' call, jwt.encode('utf-8') at line 358, is Python's str.encode method - text encoding, not a cipher.

labelled_files.reviewer_notes: The crypto-bearing module. HMACAlgorithm.sign at :494 calls hmac.new - a real MAC construction. RSAAlgorithm.from_jwk at :548, RSAPrivateKey loading at :754 and :973 are genuine key-load sites (three occurrences, one canonical asset). HMACAlgorithm references hashlib.sha256/sha512 as ClassVar HashlibHash at :320/:322. RSAAlgorithm registers RS256/RS384/RS512 at :156-158 and imports rsa_crt_dmp1/dmq1/iqmp plus rsa_recover_prime_factors at :66-69, and asymmetric padding at :40. ECDHAlgorithm and ECAlgorithm are declared in the same registry block.

labelled_files.negative_reason: Orchestration layer: _validate_claims, encode/decode dispatch and exception mapping. Delegates all primitives to algorithms.py.

labelled_files.reviewer_notes: JWK key parsing: converts between JSON Web Keys and cryptography key objects for RSA and EC families. Key material handling, not new primitives.
Performs HTTPS fetches of JWKS endpoints. TLS transport is a cryptographic surface even though the library does not implement the handshake.
base64url_encode/decode helpers. Encoding, not cryptography, but worth cataloguing as a cryptographic-adjacent transform.

labelled_files.negative_reason: Type declarations only (TypeVars and TypedDicts). No executable cryptographic operations.

known_detector_gaps.why: The registry builds these as class instances, so the RSA constructor and the hash selection are not adjacent to a call expression the AST detector can bind. This is a genuine recall gap in signature-algorithm discovery.

known_detector_gaps.missed: hashlib.sha256 / hashlib.sha512 as class-level HashlibHash attributes
known_detector_gaps.why: Assigned to a ClassVar, not called in place. Detected only when actually invoked downstream.
CRT parameter handling inside a guarded optional-dependency import block. Import-level crypto indicators are not currently treated as findings.
